title: Normalize WebView map line-ending checks
summary: Make the generated WebView map freshness check invariant to LF versus CRLF checkout line endings.
reason: The map renderer emits LF while an equivalent Windows checkout can contain CRLF, so the byte-for-byte check reported an unchanged report as stale in GitHub Actions.
behavior_before: The WebView map check compared generated text with the report byte-for-byte and failed when only CRLF versus LF line endings differed.
behavior_after: The WebView map check canonicalizes CRLF to LF before comparing generated and checked-in report text, while still rejecting substantive content drift.
manual_validation: GREEN: the focused line-ending regression and all three WebView tooling tests passed after canonicalizing the comparison.
RED: test_godfile_map_check_accepts_crlf_report_content failed because the analyzer treated equivalent CRLF report content as stale.
npm run webview:map:check passed after the repair.
npm run webview:prework:check passed after the repair.
rollback_plan: Revert the line-ending canonicalization and regression test only if map freshness must deliberately be byte-sensitive; rerun the focused regression and WebView prework checks before publishing.
notes:
